annotations.title: Open the Summer workspace for a human to choose a queued message and click Send now outside sending hours

description: Open the Summer workspace for a human to choose a queued message and click Send now outside sending hours. Returns a UI handoff only; API, CLI and MCP callers cannot override hours or send a message. The signed-in person must have current sending access. Consent, ordering, exact approvals and original receipt checks remain enforced.
